integrity: The theorem has an explicit exact finite-state proof and analytical uniform error bound; finite exact checks complement rather than replace the proof. Historical priority is not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: The complete bipartite graph has balanced parts and only pairwise-disjoint forbidden edges; the algorithm is uniform feasible-edge greedy matching. The uniform constant 36 is not optimized. Older general greedy-matching full texts could contain related special cases.
title: Uniform logarithmic correction for greedy matching with partially forbidden pairs
